inventedEvidence.evidence: 'From what you have checked' - the customer had not performed or reported any checks, only a single opening message.

rationale: The assistant correctly told the customer to stop resetting the RCD and unplug the machine, and to get an engineer in, which is the right safety boundary. But it escalated after one message without asking anything useful, such as whether trips only happen on hot washes or which device trips. It also said 'From what you have checked' when the customer had reported no checks, which is invented context. It gave no diagnostic direction such as a likely earth leakage fault, and did not explain that an insulation test is needed.
critical_note: Escalation was premature but the stop-use advice was sound.
